notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
✅ Adjusted difficulty for a fairer challenge
✅ Map size is now smaller for a more enjoyable experience
✅ You can now get to Shibosu without going through the maze

— Hidden Palace 🏛️

notes.title: Major Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Now with flooding!

[list]
[*] New flooding feature
[*] Many various quality of life improvements
[*] Improvements to environment design
[*] Orb reveal mechanic updated for a more intuitive player experience
[*] New entrance to The Bathrooms in the school
[*] Rubber ducks now increase your luck
[*] Bug fixes for AI
[*] Remapped default controls to a more expected layout
[*] Gameplay hint improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Small update/patch notes v1.0.21
notes.content: Once enabled, the skip intro checkbox in the main menu is now checked by default.

notes.title: Small update/patch notes v1.0.20
notes.content: Fixed an issue where it was possible to unlock the "Letting Things Go" achievement too early.

notes.title: Update/patch notes v1.0.19 (and prior versions)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved balance in multiple areas of the game
[*] Copium blood level now only depletes while moving
[*] Improved UI/hints for better player experience
[*] Nightmare difficulty now must be unlocked by beating hard difficulty
[/list]
